heading: Bring us the opportunity. We’ll help make it happen.
intro: We work with partners, owners, lenders and receivers in several ways: developing together, managing development on an owner’s behalf, or recovering a project that has stalled. Affiliated Elevate brings preconstruction and construction management.

proof.label: Investing and building in the GTA
Rental homes under construction or planned at Everston, Cliffside and Retreat
Homes at Merge Condos, completed in 2023

items.title: Joint development
items.body: We work with partners to combine development expertise, construction planning and the resources needed to advance residential projects.

items.title: Development management
items.body: We act as an extension of ownership, coordinating the day-to-day work of feasibility, approvals, design, budgets and delivery. The scope is tailored to the project and the owner’s requirements.

items.title: Project recovery
items.body: We work with owners, lenders and receivers to assess challenging projects, coordinate outstanding development and construction work, and establish a practical completion strategy.

items.title: Landowners and community institutions
items.body: We welcome conversations about development opportunities and existing properties where a coordinated approach can help establish the right next steps.

items.title: Development and construction, working together
items.body: LCH leads feasibility, approvals, design coordination and owner oversight. Elevate leads preconstruction and construction management. Working together early lets cost, trade input and sequencing inform the design.

items.title: Full-cycle experience
items.body: We have carried a development through approvals, design, construction, occupancy and closeout.

items.title: We take on complex sites
items.body: Heritage buildings and constrained infill sites are where coordinated development and construction thinking matter most.

items.title: We rethink the plan when the market moves
items.body: We would rather redesign a project than force it, testing unit mix and building systems against cost and long-term operation.

items.title: Project recovery
items.body: We help owners, lenders and receivers restore budget and schedule visibility and find a practical route to completion.

items.title: Transparent by default
items.body: Clear reporting, open conversations and visible responsibilities support informed decisions throughout a project.

criteria.heading: Opportunities we welcome
items: Residential and mixed-use development opportunities across the GTA
Infill sites and existing properties with redevelopment potential
Partially completed projects that need a path to completion
Owners beyond the GTA: we welcome a project-specific conversation

steps.title: Introduce
steps.body: Tell us about the site, the project or the challenge.

steps.title: Evaluate
steps.body: We review planning context, design, cost and schedule, with input from Elevate on constructability.

steps.title: Agree the scope
steps.body: We agree on the right role: joint development, development management or project recovery.

steps.title: Coordinate and build
steps.body: We coordinate approvals, design and delivery with Elevate, with regular owner reporting throughout.

steps.title: Carry it through
steps.body: We support occupancy, turnover and closeout, and stay involved through lease-up where relevant.

form.heading: Start a conversation
form.intro: Share a few details and the right person on our team will get back to you. Everything you send is kept confidential.

worked.heading: Partners we’ve worked with.
worked.intro: Our projects bring together capital partners, clients, design teams, trades and community organizations.
